title: DNA Polyacrylamide Gel Electrophoresis
author: Lívia Sacchetto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pxadpie
materials: Analyse the gel using the Safe Imager™ 2.0 Blue-Light Transilluminator (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Assemble gel casting apparatus
steps.instruction: Place the two glass plates together with spacers inside the gel caster to form the casting mold.

steps.title: Prepare 8% polyacrylamide gel solution
steps.instruction: Mix the reagents required for an 8 % polyacrylamide gel solution according to the standard recipe.

steps.title: Add TEMED and pour gel quickly
steps.instruction: Add TEMED to the gel solution and work rapidly to pour the solution into the assembled mold before polymerization begins.

steps.title: Insert comb and eliminate bubbles
steps.instruction: Place the appropriate comb into the liquid gel, taking care to avoid air bubbles under the teeth, fill any remaining space with leftover gel solution, and verify that no gel leaks from the mold.

substeps.instruction: Insert the comb immediately after pouring the gel.
Check for and remove any trapped air bubbles.
Use remaining gel solution to fill the mold completely if needed.
Ensure no acrylamide solution is leaking from the mold.

steps.title: Polymerize gel
steps.instruction: Allow the gel to polymerize for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer gel to electrophoresis tank
steps.instruction: When polymerized, remove the gel from the caster, place it into the gel box, add 1× TBE buffer, and carefully pull the comb out of the solidified gel.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gel from the gel caster.
Insert the gel into the gel box.
Add 1× TBE buffer to cover the gel.
Gently remove the comb from the polymerized gel.

steps.title: Prepare DNA samples with loading buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of each DNA sample with 2 µl of 6× gel loading buffer, then load the mixture into the wells using a micropipette.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Connect the gel box electrodes to a power pack, turn on the power, and run the gel at 100 V for 1 hour.

steps.title: Stop run and discard buffer
steps.instruction: Turn off the power, disconnect the leads, and discard the electrophoresis buffer from the reservoirs.

steps.title: Disassemble gel plates
steps.instruction: Detach the upper glass plate from the lower plate, remove the spacers, lift a corner of the upper plate with a spacer, verify the gel remains attached to the lower plate, and pull the upper plate away smoothly.

substeps.instruction: Detach the glass plates and remove the spacers.
Use a spacer to lift a corner of the upper plate.
Check that the gel stays attached to the lower plate.
Pull the upper plate away smoothly.

steps.title: Stain gels with SYBR Gold
steps.instruction: Stain each gel with 1× SYBR Gold (Invitrogen) prepared in 70 µl MilliQ water; incubate two gels for 30 minutes.
